name: Goodnotes
description:
Note taking, Planner & Journal

Take Goodnotes wherever you work
The ultimate note-taking experience for professionals who rely on a tablet

✰ Notetaking ✰
Boost productivity with AI-powered note taking
Capture ideas and organize your notes in one place so decisions, action items, and insights never get lost. Annotate documents, search handwriting, and use AI to find answers in seconds.

✰ Whiteboard ✰
Whiteboard: Infinite space for big ideas 
Create, plan and brainstorm on an infinite canvas with Goodnotes' digital whiteboard, ensuring your ideas have space to come to life.

✰ Text Document ✰
Text documents that evolve with your ideas
Bring polished, professional documents to life seamlessly, keeping context, conversation, and thinking connected in one place.

✰ PDF Annotation ✰
Turn static PDFs into living documents
Handwrite, highlight, and comment naturally, then instantly search, refine, and share your annotated PDFs without losing context.

✰ AI Productivity ✰
AI that works the way you think
Goodnotes AI supports how you naturally work, helping you find answers, clarify ideas, and move from notes to action, all embedded directly within your workspace.

✰ Collaboration ✰
Real-time collaboration built into your notes, documents, and whiteboards
A platform designed to help you collaborate wherever you need. Share notebooks, whiteboards, and text documents securely, work together in real time, and keep ideas, feedback, and decisions connected in one place.

✰ Meeting Notes ✰
Turn talk into action with Goodnotes AI for Meetings
Stay present in the conversation while AI handles the notes. Record, transcribe, and summarize your meetings in real-time, capturing decisions and action items so your team can move forward quickly.

✰ Audio Recordings ✰
Capture every word, focus on the conversation
Record audio while you take notes and keep them perfectly in sync. With Audio Recording, you can revisit any moment from a meeting, lecture, or conversation by simply tapping on your handwriting.

✰ Handwriting Experience ✰
Write like it’s paper. Edit like it’s digital
Goodnotes is built for stylus-first thinking. Capture ideas naturally, then refine them in seconds with Smart Ink—so your notes stay easy to read and easy to build on as your day moves fast.
